trigger: PUB-P2E03 preregistered Reference calibration matrix blocked: 115 of 162 cases failed hard Reference validity; representative probes showed legacy-reference-retry with aggregate residual sum slightly above 1e-12 cm while local balance and head flags were often zero.
scope: Reference solver numerical adjudication only. This workunit does not alter, rescue or reinterpret the immutable failed P2E03 matrix.

stage_A_failure_census.domain: exact 162 P2E03 material x Se x forcing x dt cases
classification_at_first_failed_stage: RETRY_TOTAL_ONLY: status retry, local balance flags=0, head flags=0, max abs compartment residual <=1e-12, abs residual sum >1e-12
RETRY_LOCAL_BALANCE: one or more local balance flags
RETRY_HEAD: one or more head flags
RETRY_MIXED: both local balance and head flags
RETRY_OTHER: retry not explained by those observable criteria
stage_A_failure_census.required_output: counts by class, failed stage and dt level; retain every case

cases: B01 Se=0.65 NOMINAL dt=0.0004 coarse failure archetype
B01 Se=0.65 DRYING dt=0.0016 half1 failure archetype
O18 Se=0.85 NOMINAL dt=0.0016 half2 failure archetype
B12 Se=0.65 WETTING dt=0.0004 full-pass control
B01 Se=0.85 NOMINAL dt=0.0016 full-pass control
stage_B_iteration_sweep.decision_observation: If a strict 1e-12 failure becomes accepted solely by increasing max_iterations, mark it ITERATION_RESOLVABLE. Otherwise retain the observed residual/flag trajectory without changing criteria.

required_observations: workspace residual high-precision accumulated sum when compiler kind is available
endpoint pressure-head/water-content differences relative to the tightest accepted tolerance for that same trajectory
stage_C_total_tolerance_sweep.interpretation_boundary: This sweep diagnoses numerical sensitivity only. The smallest accepting total tolerance is not automatically a new production tolerance and is not a RossFast admissibility threshold.

stage_D_conclusion_rules: Do not call a retry an arithmetic summation artifact unless alternative accumulation changes the aggregate residual materially relative to the 1e-12 criterion.
Do not call it an iteration-budget issue unless strict 1e-12 acceptance is recovered at a larger preregistered iteration budget.

If aggregate-only retries persist at 64 iterations with locally converged residual/head flags, describe them as an observed aggregate residual floor under the current Reference formulation, not as proven floating-point roundoff.
Any proposal to alter production numerical tolerances or to preregister a replacement calibration matrix must be a later, separate decision after this evidence is frozen.
next_permitted_action: Implement Stage A census first. Stage B/C execution is permitted only with the exact preregistered cases and ladders above; no new RossFast output may be consulted.
